title: cohomological-framework
description: A choice of how the cohomology of a settling-sheaf is computed: which category-theoretic object the per-base-point fiber of the bitopological settling site is read as, which cohomology theory runs on it, and which value category the sheaf takes values in. The corpus carries four distinct such frameworks, each internally consistent in scope, with only partial relationships between them.

fiber-reading.description: the category-theoretic object the per-base-point fiber of the bitopological settling site is treated as (e.g. substitution tile space, discrete points, order complex of the clopen lattice, or the Grothendieck site as a whole)

cohomology-theory.description: the cohomology theory computed on that fiber object (e.g. Cech of the Anderson-Putnam direct limit, Tarski-Laplacian fixed-point, cellular-sheaf parallel-pair, Lawvere-Laplacian weighted-meet)

value-category.description: the category in which the sheaf takes its values (e.g. Z-modules, d-frames, or Q-Cat_cwl)

internally-consistent.description: each framework is internally consistent within its own scope

scope.description: the settlings / regimes over which the framework's results hold (e.g. the benchmark suite, strict and Scott-continuous regimes, graphs and 2-dim degree-0, or scaffolding-only)
